officialLinks.label: Grade values; GPA calculation; P/F and S/U

helpIntro: Rice uses a 4.0 scale weighted by semester credit hours. Enter final Rice grades and credit hours to estimate your current, cumulative, projected, or target GPA.
helpNote: A+ and A are both 4.00. P and S/U grades are excluded from GPA, while F counts at 0.00. Rice counts all letter-graded repeat attempts, so Repeat Impact is disabled; enter each attempt separately.
helpExample: A 3-credit A- earns 11.01 quality points; a 3-credit B earns 9.00. Together, 20.01 ÷ 6 = 3.335.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ and A are both 4.00 at Rice.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 and attempted credit hours count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from GPA; a failing P/F outcome is recorded as F and counts.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory is excluded from GPA and earns no credit.
gradeExplanations.AUD: Audit has no credit hours and no GPA effect.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit for audit has no credit hours and no GPA effect.
gradeExplanations.NG: Administrative No Grade is non-punitive and excluded.
gradeExplanations.INC: Incomplete is temporary; use the final grade when resolved.
gradeExplanations.OT: Other is temporary; use the final grade when resolved.
gradeExplanations.SA: Study Away placeholder carries no grade points or credit hours.
gradeExplanations.TR: Transfer credit normally has no effect on Rice GPA.

specialTypes.name: Rice course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter Rice semester credit hours and the final posted grade.

specialTypes.name: Ordinary transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Transferred grades normally do not enter the Rice GPA; TR has no GPA effect.

specialTypes.name: Program-required external coursework
specialTypes.note: Some explicitly specified program curriculum taken elsewhere may be entered and counted in Rice GPA; verify the program rule before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each letter-graded Rice attempt as a separate completed course. The Repeat Impact estimator is disabled because Rice does not use ordinary grade replacement.
